name: webcrawl
description: Lets agents search the web, read pages as clean Markdown, extract structured data, map and crawl sites, parse documents, and monitor pages. Runs locally with no API key, or with webcrawl.app. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Prefer search_categories and web_parse_status for status and category reads; review web_rerank because cloud mode can send documents to the cloud API.
Review every URL and query in web_search, web_read, web_parse, web_map, web_crawl, web_extract, and web_monitor before approving. Those tools fetch remote content or start network work.
web_monitor can create, change, or delete scheduled watches and send email or webhook alerts. Review the action, URLs, and notify targets before approving.
Set WEBCRAWL_MODE=local so the server stays on the local engine instead of calling webcrawl.app.
Pin the npm package to a reviewed version such as @webcrawl/mcp@1.4.5.
